traceDiagram.title: Trade Pokemon command flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `main()` of the `pokedex` command [checks whether its first argument is `trade`](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L8). It also shows what happens when a user runs `pokedex trade` with a Pokemon id and a trainer id, and how the new trade reaches the database through [`session.commit()`](code:src/pokedex/trades/service.py#L13).

traceNodes.label: Runs a trade for the trade command, then prints the team
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex trade` with a Pokemon id and a trainer id, Python calls this function, because `[project.scripts]` of `pyproject.toml` names `pokedex.cli:main`.

blockLabels.label: Calls trade_pokemon when the command is trade to give the Pokemon to the trainer
Calls team_report when the command is trade to write the team of the new trainer
Returns after the trade when the command is trade
Calls team_report to write the team of the trainer of the first argument

traceNodes.label: Moves one Pokemon to another trainer and records the trade
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex trade`, [`main()` calls this function](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L9) with the second and third arguments as ids. The function [opens one `Session` on the engine](code:src/pokedex/trades/service.py#L9) for every query of the trade.

blockLabels.label: Calls find_pokemon to load the Pokemon to trade
Calls find_trainer to load the trainer who gets the Pokemon
Calls save_trade to record the trade and move the Pokemon
Returns the id of the saved trade

traceNodes.label: Loads one Pokemon by its id
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex trade`, `main()` calls `trade_pokemon()`, and [`trade_pokemon()` calls this function first](code:src/pokedex/trades/service.py#L10). `one()` raises `NoResultFound` when no Pokemon has the id.

triggerLabels.label: The Pokemon of the id is loaded
The pokemon table is queried by id

blockLabels.label: Returns the one Pokemon with the id

traceNodes.label: Adds a trade row and gives the Pokemon to the new trainer
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex trade`, `main()` calls `trade_pokemon()`, and [`trade_pokemon()` calls this function](code:src/pokedex/trades/service.py#L12) with the loaded Pokemon and trainer. Nothing reaches the database until [`trade_pokemon()` commits the session](code:src/pokedex/trades/service.py#L13).
